# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_ebase.py - do not edit manually.
# Extraplanetary Base ground types (ground types design § 5, § 8), country scope.
# See scripts/generators/gen_ebase.py; sr_ebase_refresh (sr_colony_module_effects.txt)
# calls them.

# Our levels on each mining method, and on all of them (§ 8.3's f(m)), into
# var:sr_eb_lv_<pm> and var:sr_eb_lv_mining for sr_eb_share_<pm>: one walk of our
# Extraplanetary Bases. A method outside the seven goods is not counted.
sr_eb_count_methods = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_space_mine value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners value = 0 }
	every_scope_state = {
		every_scope_building = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_space_mine }
			if = { limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_regolith_processing } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing add = level } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_space_mine } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_space_mine add = level } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_space_colony_mining } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining add = level } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_self_replicating_miners } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners add = level } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lv_pm_regolith_processing value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lv_pm_space_mine value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_mine }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lv_pm_space_colony_mining value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lv_pm_self_replicating_miners value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners }
	set_variable = {
		name = sr_eb_lv_mining
		value = {
			value = 0
			add = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing
			add = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_mine
			add = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining
			add = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners
		}
	}
	# The method most of our mining levels run (ebase_ground.lead_method): its position in
	# the mining methods' order, the first on a tie, -1 with no mining levels. The Bases view
	# gives output a level for it.
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_lead value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_most value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing > local_var:sr_ebc_most } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_lead value = 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_most value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_regolith_processing } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_mine > local_var:sr_ebc_most } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_lead value = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_most value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_mine } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining > local_var:sr_ebc_most } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_lead value = 2 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_most value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_space_colony_mining } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners > local_var:sr_ebc_most } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_lead value = 3 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebc_most value = local_var:sr_ebc_pm_self_replicating_miners } }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_lead_method value = local_var:sr_ebc_lead }
}

# The month (§ 8.2's steps 1 to 5, ebase_ground.month rule for rule): where the
# country's levels work. The inputs are read once and the record loaded into locals;
# displacement, return and levels gained or lost follow what happened, at once;
# then, once the first placement is made (sr_eb_placed, § 8.8: a country with no
# record places all its levels at once by the rule in force), the paced moves. The
# record goes back to the country's variables at the end.
sr_eb_month = {
	sr_eb_read_inputs = yes
	sr_eb_store_profits = yes
	sr_eb_load = yes
	# Step 2: displacement
	sr_eb_displace = yes
	# Step 3: return
	sr_eb_return = yes
	# Step 4: levels gained or lost
	sr_eb_gain_lose = yes
	# Step 5: the paced moves, the month's pace once a calendar month (§ 8.5). The
	# refresh also runs the day after a base level is built (space_race_events.110):
	# that run follows what happened (steps 2 to 4, which change nothing run again
	# on the same inputs) and leaves the moves and their record to the month's first
	# run (sr_eb_moved_month, te_history_month_index).
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mfrom value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mto value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mn value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = sr_eb_placed
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = sr_eb_moved_month }
				var:sr_eb_moved_month < te_history_month_index
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_moved_month value = te_history_month_index }
		sr_eb_moves = yes
		sr_eb_record_move = yes
	}
	# The first placement (§ 8.8): every level at once; the moves begin next month.
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_built > 0 NOT = { has_variable = sr_eb_placed } }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_placed value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_moved_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	sr_eb_store = yes
}

# The month's inputs, read once into locals (§ 8.2 step 1, § 8.3, § 8.5): the places
# (sr_eb_read_places) and each place's profit a level (sr_ebi_p_<k>, sr_eb_read_profits,
# which evaluates the margins at this month's prices). The passes then compare locals.
sr_eb_read_inputs = {
	sr_eb_read_places = yes
	sr_eb_read_profits = yes
}
# A click's inputs (sr_eb_after_click): the places as the month reads them, and the
# profits the last refresh stored (sr_eb_read_stored_profits), never the margins again.
sr_eb_read_click_inputs = {
	sr_eb_read_places = yes
	sr_eb_read_stored_profits = yes
}
# Each place's held (sr_ebi_held_<k>, 1 or 0), serving us (sr_ebi_sv_<k>: held, not

# built levels and the pace.

# The seven margins once (sr_eb_margin_<type>), then each place's profit a level,
# (1 + grade) x its type's margin (sr_ebi_p_<k>, as sr_eb_profit_<k> reads it); the
# yardstick (sr_ebi_yard) and the move's margin, 0.05 of it (sr_ebi_margin); a
# level's profit past all of the room (sr_ebi_p_over).
sr_eb_read_profits = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_m_mixed value = sr_eb_margin_mixed }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_m_metallic value = sr_eb_margin_metallic }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_m_rocky value = sr_eb_margin_rocky }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_m_carbonaceous value = sr_eb_margin_carbonaceous }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_m_sulfurous value = sr_eb_margin_sulfurous }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_m_hydrocarbon value = sr_eb_margin_hydrocarbon }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_m_icy value = sr_eb_margin_icy }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_yard value = sr_eb_yardstick }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_margin value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_yard multiply = 0.05 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_near_earth value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_mixed multiply = 100 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_valles_marineris value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 110 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_olympus_mons value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 110 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_hellas_planitia value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 110 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_utopia_planitia value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 110 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_arcadia_planitia value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 110 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_ceres value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_carbonaceous multiply = 115 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_vesta value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 120 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_psyche value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_metallic multiply = 130 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_pallas value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_carbonaceous multiply = 110 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_hygiea value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_carbonaceous multiply = 105 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_io value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_sulfurous multiply = 95 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_europa value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_sulfurous multiply = 95 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_ganymede value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 100 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_callisto value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_carbonaceous multiply = 100 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_himalia value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_carbonaceous multiply = 105 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_amalthea value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_sulfurous multiply = 100 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_venus value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_sulfurous multiply = 90 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_mercury value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 105 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_titan value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_hydrocarbon multiply = 85 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_enceladus value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_carbonaceous multiply = 80 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_rhea value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 85 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_mimas value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 80 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_iapetus value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_hydrocarbon multiply = 80 divide = 100 } }

	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_triton value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 70 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_proteus value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 65 divide = 100 } }

	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_makemake value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_hydrocarbon multiply = 60 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_haumea value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 60 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_sedna value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_hydrocarbon multiply = 55 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_shackleton value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 100 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_peary value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_icy multiply = 100 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_tranquility value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 105 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_marius_hills value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 105 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_daedalus value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 100 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_imbrium value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_rocky multiply = 100 divide = 100 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_over value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_m_mixed multiply = 25 divide = 100 } }
}

# The month's profit figures, stored at every refresh for every country (the Bases view
# reads them, and a click's forecast and totals: the margins are evaluated once a refresh):
# var:sr_eb_level_profit_<k>, each place's profit a level a week, and var:sr_eb_yardstick.
sr_eb_store_profits = {
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_near_earth value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_near_earth }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_valles_marineris value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_valles_marineris }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_olympus_mons value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_olympus_mons }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_hellas_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_hellas_planitia }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_utopia_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_utopia_planitia }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_arcadia_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_arcadia_planitia }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_ceres value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_ceres }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_vesta value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_vesta }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_psyche value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_psyche }

	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_enceladus value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_enceladus }

	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_titania value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_titania }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_oberon value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_oberon }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_miranda value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_miranda }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_ariel value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_ariel }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_triton value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_triton }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_proteus value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_proteus }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_pluto value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_pluto }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_eris value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_eris }

	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_sedna value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_sedna }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_shackleton value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_shackleton }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_peary value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_peary }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_tranquility value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_tranquility }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_marius_hills value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_marius_hills }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_daedalus value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_daedalus }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_level_profit_imbrium value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_imbrium }
	set_variable = { name = sr_eb_yardstick value = local_var:sr_ebi_yard }
}
# The stored figures back into the month's locals, as sr_eb_read_profits sets them (a level
# past the room earns a near-Earth level's, Mixed at grade 0, x 25 / 100). 0 before any refresh.
sr_eb_read_stored_profits = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_near_earth value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_near_earth } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_near_earth value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_near_earth } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_valles_marineris value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_valles_marineris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_valles_marineris value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_valles_marineris } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_olympus_mons value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_olympus_mons } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_olympus_mons value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_olympus_mons } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_hellas_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_hellas_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_hellas_planitia value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_hellas_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_utopia_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_utopia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_utopia_planitia value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_utopia_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_arcadia_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_arcadia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_arcadia_planitia value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_arcadia_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_ceres value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_ceres } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_ceres value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_ceres } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_vesta value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_vesta } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_vesta value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_vesta } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_psyche value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_psyche } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_psyche value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_psyche } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_pallas value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_pallas } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_pallas value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_pallas } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_hygiea value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_hygiea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_hygiea value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_hygiea } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_io value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_io } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_io value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_io } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_europa value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_europa } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_europa value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_europa } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_ganymede value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_ganymede } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_ganymede value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_ganymede } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_callisto value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_callisto } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_callisto value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_callisto } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_himalia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_himalia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_himalia value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_himalia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_amalthea value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_amalthea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_amalthea value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_amalthea } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_venus value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_venus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_venus value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_venus } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_mercury value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_mercury } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_mercury value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_mercury } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_titan value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_titan } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_titan value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_titan } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_enceladus value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_enceladus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_enceladus value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_enceladus } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_rhea value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_rhea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_rhea value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_rhea } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_mimas value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_mimas } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_mimas value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_mimas } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_iapetus value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_iapetus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_iapetus value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_iapetus } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_titania value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_titania } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_titania value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_titania } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_oberon value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_oberon } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_oberon value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_oberon } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_miranda value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_miranda } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_miranda value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_miranda } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_ariel value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_ariel } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_ariel value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_ariel } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_triton value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_triton } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_triton value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_triton } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_proteus value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_proteus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_proteus value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_proteus } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_pluto value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_pluto } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_pluto value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_pluto } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_eris value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_eris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_eris value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_eris } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_makemake value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_makemake } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_makemake value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_makemake } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_haumea value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_haumea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_haumea value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_haumea } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_sedna value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_sedna } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_sedna value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_sedna } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_shackleton value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_shackleton } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_shackleton value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_shackleton } }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_peary } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_peary value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_peary } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_tranquility value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_tranquility } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_tranquility value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_tranquility } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_marius_hills value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_marius_hills } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_marius_hills value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_marius_hills } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_daedalus value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_daedalus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_daedalus value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_daedalus } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_imbrium value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_level_profit_imbrium } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_imbrium value = var:sr_eb_level_profit_imbrium } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_yard value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_yardstick } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_yard value = var:sr_eb_yardstick } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_margin value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_yard multiply = 0.05 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebi_p_over value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_near_earth multiply = 25 divide = 100 } }
}

# The country's record into locals (§ 8.1): the levels at each place (sr_ebm_at_<k>),
# past the room (sr_ebm_over), each place target and away. Unset
# reads 0 (a place's variables are removed at 0).
sr_eb_load = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_near_earth value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_near_earth } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_near_earth value = var:sr_eb_at_near_earth } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_near_earth value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_near_earth } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_near_earth value = var:sr_eb_target_near_earth } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_near_earth value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_near_earth } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_near_earth value = var:sr_eb_away_near_earth } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_valles_marineris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris value = var:sr_eb_at_valles_marineris } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_valles_marineris value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_valles_marineris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_valles_marineris value = var:sr_eb_target_valles_marineris } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_valles_marineris value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_valles_marineris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_valles_marineris value = var:sr_eb_away_valles_marineris } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_olympus_mons } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons value = var:sr_eb_at_olympus_mons } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_olympus_mons value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_olympus_mons } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_olympus_mons value = var:sr_eb_target_olympus_mons } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_olympus_mons value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_olympus_mons } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_olympus_mons value = var:sr_eb_away_olympus_mons } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_hellas_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia value = var:sr_eb_at_hellas_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_hellas_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_hellas_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_hellas_planitia value = var:sr_eb_target_hellas_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_hellas_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_hellas_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_hellas_planitia value = var:sr_eb_away_hellas_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_utopia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia value = var:sr_eb_at_utopia_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_utopia_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_utopia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_utopia_planitia value = var:sr_eb_target_utopia_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_utopia_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_utopia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_utopia_planitia value = var:sr_eb_away_utopia_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_arcadia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia value = var:sr_eb_at_arcadia_planitia } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_arcadia_planitia value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_arcadia_planitia } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_arcadia_planitia value = var:sr_eb_target_arcadia_planitia } }

	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_ceres value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_ceres } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_ceres value = var:sr_eb_at_ceres } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_ceres value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_ceres } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_ceres value = var:sr_eb_target_ceres } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_ceres value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_ceres } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_ceres value = var:sr_eb_away_ceres } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_vesta value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_vesta } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_vesta value = var:sr_eb_at_vesta } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_vesta value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_vesta } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_vesta value = var:sr_eb_target_vesta } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_vesta value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_vesta } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_vesta value = var:sr_eb_away_vesta } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_psyche value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_psyche } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_psyche value = var:sr_eb_at_psyche } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_psyche value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_psyche } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_psyche value = var:sr_eb_target_psyche } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_psyche value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_psyche } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_psyche value = var:sr_eb_away_psyche } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_pallas value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_pallas } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_pallas value = var:sr_eb_at_pallas } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_pallas value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_pallas } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_pallas value = var:sr_eb_target_pallas } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_pallas value = 0 }

# The month's record back to the country (§ 8.1: country variables, so a revolution's
# winner keeps them): each place's levels, target and away while above 0, removed at 0;
# the levels past the room.
sr_eb_store = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_at_near_earth value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_near_earth } remove_variable = sr_eb_at_near_earth }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebr_tg_near_earth > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_near_earth value = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_near_earth }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_near_earth } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_near_earth }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebr_aw_near_earth > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_away_near_earth value = local_var:sr_ebr_aw_near_earth }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_near_earth } remove_variable = sr_eb_away_near_earth }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris > 0 }

# § 8.2 step 2, displacement, at once (ebase_ground.month): where the levels at a place
# exceed its room serving us, the excess leaves for the pool, the levels without a
# place (it starts as the levels past the room). A site held that doesn't serve us
# (blockaded or occupied) owes them back (away); room that shrank while it serves
# (a Mining Complex unstaffed) owes nothing. A place not held (ceded, captured,
# abandoned) loses its levels, target and away.
sr_eb_displace = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool value = local_var:sr_ebm_over }
	# the near-Earth asteroids (place 0)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_held_near_earth = 0 }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_near_earth value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_near_earth value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_near_earth value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth > local_var:sr_ebi_room_near_earth }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_x value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_room_near_earth } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_near_earth value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_near_earth }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_x }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_near_earth = 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_near_earth add = local_var:sr_ebm_x } }
	}
	# Valles Marineris (place 1)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_held_valles_marineris = 0 }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_valles_marineris value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_valles_marineris value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris > local_var:sr_ebi_room_valles_marineris }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_x value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_room_valles_marineris } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_valles_marineris }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_x }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_valles_marineris = 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_valles_marineris add = local_var:sr_ebm_x } }
	}
	# Olympus Mons (place 2)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_held_olympus_mons = 0 }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_olympus_mons value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_olympus_mons value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons > local_var:sr_ebi_room_olympus_mons }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_x value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_room_olympus_mons } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_olympus_mons }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_x }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_olympus_mons = 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_olympus_mons add = local_var:sr_ebm_x } }
	}
	# Hellas Planitia (place 3)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_held_hellas_planitia = 0 }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_hellas_planitia value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_hellas_planitia value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia > local_var:sr_ebi_room_hellas_planitia }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_x value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_room_hellas_planitia } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_hellas_planitia }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_x }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_hellas_planitia = 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_hellas_planitia add = local_var:sr_ebm_x } }
	}
	# Utopia Planitia (place 4)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_held_utopia_planitia = 0 }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia }

		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_utopia_planitia value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_utopia_planitia value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia > local_var:sr_ebi_room_utopia_planitia }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_x value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_room_utopia_planitia } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_utopia_planitia }

		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_utopia_planitia = 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_utopia_planitia add = local_var:sr_ebm_x } }

	# Arcadia Planitia (place 5)
	if = {

		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_arcadia_planitia value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_arcadia_planitia value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia > local_var:sr_ebi_room_arcadia_planitia }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_x value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_room_arcadia_planitia } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_arcadia_planitia }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebm_x }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_arcadia_planitia = 0 } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_arcadia_planitia add = local_var:sr_ebm_x } }

	# Ceres (place 6)
	if = {

		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_tg_ceres value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_ceres value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres > local_var:sr_ebi_room_ceres }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_x value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_room_ceres } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_ceres value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_ceres }

# § 8.2 step 3, return, at once (ebase_ground.month): a site that serves us again takes
# back up to what it is owed (away), as far as its room allows, from the levels without
# a place first, then along the take order, never from itself or a site that returned
# before it this month; its debt is then settled. Best grade first.
sr_eb_return = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_near_earth value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_valles_marineris value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_olympus_mons value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_hellas_planitia value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_utopia_planitia value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_arcadia_planitia value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_ceres value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_vesta value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_psyche value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_pallas value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_hygiea value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_io value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_europa value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_ganymede value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_callisto value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_himalia value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_amalthea value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_venus value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_mercury value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_titan value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_enceladus value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_rhea value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_mimas value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_iapetus value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_titania value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_oberon value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_miranda value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_ariel value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_triton value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_proteus value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_pluto value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_eris value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_makemake value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_haumea value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_sedna value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_shackleton value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_peary value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_tranquility value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_marius_hills value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_daedalus value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_imbrium value = 0 }
	# 16 Psyche (+30%)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_psyche = 1 local_var:sr_ebr_aw_psyche > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_owed value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_psyche subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_at_psyche max = local_var:sr_ebr_aw_psyche } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_psyche value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_psyche value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_owed > 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_fp value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed max = local_var:sr_ebm_pool } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_psyche add = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 }
				sr_eb_take_return = yes
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_psyche add = local_var:sr_ebm_got }
			}
		}
	}
	# 4 Vesta (+20%)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_vesta = 1 local_var:sr_ebr_aw_vesta > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_owed value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_vesta subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_at_vesta max = local_var:sr_ebr_aw_vesta } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_vesta value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_vesta value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_owed > 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_fp value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed max = local_var:sr_ebm_pool } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_vesta add = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 }
				sr_eb_take_return = yes
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_vesta add = local_var:sr_ebm_got }
			}
		}
	}
	# Ceres (+15%)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_ceres = 1 local_var:sr_ebr_aw_ceres > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_owed value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_ceres subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres max = local_var:sr_ebr_aw_ceres } }

			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_ceres add = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp } }
			if = {

	# Valles Marineris (+10%)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_valles_marineris = 1 local_var:sr_ebr_aw_valles_marineris > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_owed value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_valles_marineris subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris max = local_var:sr_ebr_aw_valles_marineris } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_valles_marineris value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_valles_marineris value = 1 }
		if = {

			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_fp value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed max = local_var:sr_ebm_pool } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_makemake add = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 }
				sr_eb_take_return = yes
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_makemake add = local_var:sr_ebm_got }
			}
		}
	}
	# Haumea (-40%)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_haumea = 1 local_var:sr_ebr_aw_haumea > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_owed value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_haumea subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea max = local_var:sr_ebr_aw_haumea } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_haumea value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_haumea value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_owed > 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_fp value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed max = local_var:sr_ebm_pool } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_haumea add = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 }
				sr_eb_take_return = yes
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_haumea add = local_var:sr_ebm_got }
			}
		}
	}
	# Sedna (-45%)
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_sv_sedna = 1 local_var:sr_ebr_aw_sedna > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_owed value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_sedna subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna max = local_var:sr_ebr_aw_sedna } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_aw_sedna value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebr_ret_sedna value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_owed > 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_fp value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed max = local_var:sr_ebm_pool } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_sedna add = local_var:sr_ebm_fp }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_owed subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_fp } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 }
				sr_eb_take_return = yes
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_sedna add = local_var:sr_ebm_got }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Where levels leave first, for levels lost.
sr_eb_take_lost = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_got value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_manual }
		# Above their target first, worst grade first, down to the target
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_sedna }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_sedna max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_sedna subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_got add = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_haumea }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_haumea max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_haumea subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_got add = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_makemake }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_makemake max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_makemake subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_got add = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_eris }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_eris max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_eris subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_got add = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_pluto }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_pluto max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }

		if = {

		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 local_var:sr_ebm_at_triton > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_triton }

					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_proteus max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_proteus subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 30 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_pluto subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 31 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_eris subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 32 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_makemake subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 33 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_haumea subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 34 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_sedna subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 35 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_shackleton max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_shackleton subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 36 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_peary max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_peary subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}

					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_tranquility subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 38 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_marius_hills max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_marius_hills subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 39 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_daedalus max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_daedalus subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_tsrc = 40 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_tk value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_imbrium max = local_var:sr_ebm_need } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_imbrium subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				}
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_got add = local_var:sr_ebm_tk }
			}
		}
	}
}

# § 8.2 step 4, levels gained or lost (ebase_ground.month): the built levels against
# those on record. New levels join the pool; lost levels come off the pool first (the
# levels past the room, and those displaced this month), then along the take order. The
# pool then goes where new levels go; what fits nowhere is past the room.
sr_eb_gain_lose = {
	set_local_variable = {
		name = sr_ebm_have
		value = {
			value = local_var:sr_ebm_pool
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_vesta
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_psyche
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pallas
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hygiea
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_io
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_europa
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ganymede
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_callisto
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_himalia
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_amalthea
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_venus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mercury
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titan
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_enceladus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_rhea
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mimas
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_iapetus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titania
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_oberon
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_miranda
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ariel
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_triton
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_proteus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_shackleton
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_peary
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_tranquility
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_marius_hills
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_daedalus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_imbrium
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_built > local_var:sr_ebm_have }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_pool add = local_var:sr_ebi_built subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_have } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_built < local_var:sr_ebm_have }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_lose value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_have subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_built } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_cut value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_lose max = local_var:sr_ebm_pool } }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pool subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_cut }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_need value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_lose subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_cut } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_need > 0 } sr_eb_take_lost = yes }
	}
	sr_eb_place_new = yes
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_over value = local_var:sr_ebm_pool }
}

# § 8.2 step 5, the paced moves: up to the pace (sr_ebi_pace), pass after pass.
sr_eb_moves = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_left value = local_var:sr_ebi_pace }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pass value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_go value = 1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mfrom value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mto value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mn value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_go = 1 local_var:sr_ebm_left > 0 local_var:sr_ebm_pass < 42 }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_pass add = 1 }
		sr_eb_move_pass = yes
	}
	# Never, if the rule above holds: a pass empties a place or fills one for good.
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_go = 1 local_var:sr_ebm_left > 0 local_var:sr_ebm_pass >= 42 }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_EBASE sr_eb_moves: the moves stopped at their ceiling of 42 passes with pace left; country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetTagName] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
	}
}

# One move pass (§ 8.3 with the checkbox on, § 8.4 with it off).
sr_eb_move_pass = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_dst value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_ok value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_manual }
		# By hand (§ 8.4): from the first place above its target, worst grade first, to the
		# first below it with free room, best grade first. A level no target calls for stays.
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_sedna }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 34 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_sedna } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_haumea }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 33 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_haumea } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_makemake }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 32 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_makemake } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_eris }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 31 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_eris } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_pluto }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 30 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_pluto } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_proteus > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_proteus }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 29 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_proteus subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_proteus } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_triton > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_triton }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 28 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_triton subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_triton } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_ariel > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_ariel }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 27 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ariel subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_ariel } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_at_miranda > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_miranda }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_src value = 26 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_miranda subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_miranda } }
		}
		else_if = {

			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_pluto add = local_var:sr_ebm_n }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_dst = 31 }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_eris add = local_var:sr_ebm_n }

			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_dst = 37 }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_tranquility add = local_var:sr_ebm_n }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_dst = 38 }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_at_marius_hills add = local_var:sr_ebm_n }
		}

		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_dst = 40 }

		}
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_left subtract = local_var:sr_ebm_n }
		# The month's move (§ 9.1, § 9.4): its first pair, and the levels it carried
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_mfrom < 0 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mfrom value = local_var:sr_ebm_src } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mto value = local_var:sr_ebm_dst } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_mfrom = local_var:sr_ebm_src local_var:sr_ebm_mto = local_var:sr_ebm_dst } change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_mn add = local_var:sr_ebm_n } }
	}
	else = { set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_go value = 0 } }
}

# The move record (§ 9.1, § 9.4), country variables: the current move's source and
# destination (sr_eb_move_from, _to, place indices), the month it began and the latest
# month it carried levels (sr_eb_move_began, _latest, te_history_month_index) and the
# levels it has carried (sr_eb_move_carried, for the notice's 5%); the last move's
# (sr_eb_last_from, _to, _began, _ended: its first and last months). A month's move is
# its first pass's pair; while the pair holds it adds the levels that pair carried;
# another pair starts a new move; a month with none ends it.
# Only the paced moves count (not new levels, displacement or return).
sr_eb_end_move = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_move_from }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_last_from value = var:sr_eb_move_from }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_last_to value = var:sr_eb_move_to }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_last_began value = var:sr_eb_move_began }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_last_ended value = var:sr_eb_move_latest }
		remove_variable = sr_eb_move_from
		remove_variable = sr_eb_move_to
		remove_variable = sr_eb_move_began
		remove_variable = sr_eb_move_latest
		remove_variable = sr_eb_move_carried
	}
}
sr_eb_record_move = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_same value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_move_from }
		if = { limit = { var:sr_eb_move_from = local_var:sr_ebm_mfrom var:sr_eb_move_to = local_var:sr_ebm_mto } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebm_same value = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_mfrom >= 0 local_var:sr_ebm_same = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = sr_eb_move_carried add = local_var:sr_ebm_mn }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_move_latest value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebm_mfrom >= 0 }
		sr_eb_end_move = yes
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_move_from value = local_var:sr_ebm_mfrom }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_move_to value = local_var:sr_ebm_mto }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_move_began value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_move_latest value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = sr_eb_move_carried value = local_var:sr_ebm_mn }
	}
	else = { sr_eb_end_move = yes }
}

# The base's two layers (§ 5.2) from where its levels work: T, the average grade
# over the levels, past the room at -75%, into var:sr_ebase_grade (percent);
# and each good's D(g), the places' types' mixes weighted by levels x (1 + grade),
# past the room as Mixed, into var:sr_ebase_mix_<good> (signed, percent) and
# var:sr_ebase_mix_<good>_units (its size, the modifiers' multiplier). Multiplied
# first, divided last (fixed point).
sr_eb_compute_mix = {
	set_local_variable = {
		name = sr_ebx_levels
		value = {
			value = local_var:sr_ebm_over
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_vesta
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_psyche
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pallas
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hygiea
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_io
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_europa
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ganymede
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_callisto
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_himalia
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_amalthea
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_venus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mercury
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titan
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_enceladus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_rhea
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mimas
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_iapetus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titania
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_oberon
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_miranda
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ariel
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_triton
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_proteus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_shackleton
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_peary
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_tranquility
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_marius_hills
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_daedalus
			add = local_var:sr_ebm_at_imbrium
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = {
		name = sr_ebx_grade_sum
		value = {
			value = local_var:sr_ebm_over
			multiply = -75
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris multiply = 10 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons multiply = 10 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia multiply = 10 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia multiply = 10 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia multiply = 10 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres multiply = 15 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_vesta multiply = 20 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_psyche multiply = 30 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pallas multiply = 10 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hygiea multiply = 5 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_io multiply = -5 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_europa multiply = -5 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_himalia multiply = 5 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_venus multiply = -10 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mercury multiply = 5 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titan multiply = -15 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_enceladus multiply = -20 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_rhea multiply = -15 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mimas multiply = -20 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_iapetus multiply = -20 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titania multiply = -25 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_oberon multiply = -25 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_miranda multiply = -30 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ariel multiply = -30 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_triton multiply = -30 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_proteus multiply = -35 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto multiply = -35 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris multiply = -40 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake multiply = -40 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea multiply = -40 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna multiply = -45 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_tranquility multiply = 5 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_marius_hills multiply = 5 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_grade value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebx_levels > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_grade value = { value = local_var:sr_ebx_grade_sum divide = local_var:sr_ebx_levels } }
	}
	set_local_variable = {
		name = sr_ebx_weight
		value = {
			value = local_var:sr_ebm_over
			multiply = 25
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth multiply = 100 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris multiply = 110 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons multiply = 110 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia multiply = 110 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia multiply = 110 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia multiply = 110 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres multiply = 115 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_vesta multiply = 120 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_psyche multiply = 130 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pallas multiply = 110 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hygiea multiply = 105 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_io multiply = 95 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_europa multiply = 95 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ganymede multiply = 100 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_callisto multiply = 100 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_himalia multiply = 105 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_amalthea multiply = 100 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_venus multiply = 90 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mercury multiply = 105 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titan multiply = 85 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_enceladus multiply = 80 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_rhea multiply = 85 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mimas multiply = 80 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_iapetus multiply = 80 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titania multiply = 75 }

	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebx_weight > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur value = { value = local_var:sr_ebx_made multiply = 100 divide = local_var:sr_ebx_weight subtract = 100 } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_units value = var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_units value = { value = var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur multiply = -1 } }
