# The base's mix on every Extraplanetary Base building we own (§ 5.3): buildings
# hold no variables, so the figures are the country's (root.var:). sr_eb_strip_mix
# removes all fourteen from every base, with or without In-Situ Resource
# Utilization, so a captured base sheds its old owner's mix; sr_eb_apply_mix then
# adds one a good, the bonus or the penalty by its sign, at its size. The refresh
# strips once and applies after (remove before add; a same-name add stacks).
sr_eb_strip_mix = {
	every_scope_state = {
		every_scope_building = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_space_mine }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_iron_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_iron_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_iron_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_iron_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_gold_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_gold_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_gold_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_gold_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_copper_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_copper_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_copper_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_copper_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_lead_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_lead_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_lead_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_lead_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_penalty }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_glass_bonus } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_glass_bonus }
			if = { limit = { has_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_glass_penalty } remove_modifier = sr_ebase_mix_glass_penalty }
		}
	}
}
sr_eb_apply_mix = {
	every_scope_state = {
		every_scope_building = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_space_mine }
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_iron > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_iron_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_iron_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_iron < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_iron_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_iron_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_tech_metals_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_gold > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_gold_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_gold_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_gold < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_gold_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_gold_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_copper > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_copper_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_copper_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_copper < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_copper_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_copper_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_lead > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_lead_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_lead_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_lead < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_lead_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_lead_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_sulfur_units }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_glass > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_glass_bonus multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_glass_units }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { root.var:sr_ebase_mix_glass < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = sr_ebase_mix_glass_penalty multiplier = root.var:sr_ebase_mix_glass_units }
			}
		}
	}
}

# § 9.3, the Base Room cell (ebase_ground.next_place): where the next level goes once
# the queued levels are placed, by the rule in force, from where the month left the
# levels: the queued levels and one more go where new levels go, on a copy of the
# counts (sr_ebn_at_<k>). var:sr_ebase_next_place is that place's index, -1 past all
# of the room; var:sr_ebase_next_grade its grade (-75 past the room) and
# var:sr_ebase_next_profit its profit a level, for the cell's hover. After sr_eb_month, or
# after a click's sr_eb_read_inputs and sr_eb_load (sr_eb_after_click).
sr_eb_next_place = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_near_earth value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_valles_marineris value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_olympus_mons value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_hellas_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_utopia_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_arcadia_planitia value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_ceres value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_vesta value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_vesta }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_psyche value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_psyche }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_pallas value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pallas }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_hygiea value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hygiea }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_io value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_io }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_europa value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_europa }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_ganymede value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ganymede }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_callisto value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_callisto }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_himalia value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_himalia }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_amalthea value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_amalthea }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_venus value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_venus }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_mercury value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mercury }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_titan value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titan }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_enceladus value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_enceladus }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_rhea value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_rhea }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_mimas value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_mimas }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_iapetus value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_iapetus }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_titania value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_titania }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_oberon value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_oberon }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_miranda value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_miranda }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_ariel value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ariel }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_triton value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_triton }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_proteus value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_proteus }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_pluto value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pluto }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_eris value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_eris }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_makemake value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_makemake }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_haumea value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_haumea }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_sedna value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_sedna }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_shackleton value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_shackleton }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_peary value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_peary }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_tranquility value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_tranquility }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_marius_hills value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_marius_hills }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_daedalus value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_daedalus }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_imbrium value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_imbrium }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_pool value = { value = sr_ebase_queued_levels subtract = local_var:sr_ebi_built min = 0 add = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_put value = -1 }
	sr_eb_next_give = yes
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_pool > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_place value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = -75 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_over }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_place value = local_var:sr_ebn_put }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_near_earth }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_valles_marineris }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_olympus_mons }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_hellas_planitia }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 4 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_utopia_planitia }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 5 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_arcadia_planitia }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 6 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 15 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_ceres }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 7 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_vesta }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 8 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 30 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_psyche }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 9 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_pallas }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 10 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = 5 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_hygiea }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 11 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = -5 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_io }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebn_put = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_grade value = -5 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_ebase_next_profit value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_europa }

		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_gv value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_europa subtract = local_var:sr_ebn_at_europa max = local_var:sr_ebn_pool } }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_at_europa add = local_var:sr_ebn_gv }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebn_pool subtract = local_var:sr_ebn_gv }

# § 9.1's second row (ebase_ground.forecast): the rule in force run to where it stops,
# with no pace, on a copy of our counts (sr_ebf_at_<k>). After sr_eb_read_inputs and the
# targets' load; writes no variable.
sr_eb_forecast = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_at_near_earth value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_near_earth } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_at_near_earth value = var:sr_eb_at_near_earth } }

sr_eb_forecast_moves = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_pass value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_go value = 1 }
	while = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ebf_go = 1 local_var:sr_ebf_pass < 41 }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_pass add = 1 }
		sr_eb_forecast_pass = yes
	}
}
sr_eb_forecast_pass = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_src value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_dst value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_ok value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_manual }
		# By hand (§ 8.4): from the first place above its target, worst grade first, to the
		# first below it with free room, best grade first. A level no target calls for stays.
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebf_at_sedna > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_sedna }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_src value = 34 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebf_at_sedna subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_sedna } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebf_at_haumea > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_haumea }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_src value = 33 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebf_at_haumea subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_haumea } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebf_at_makemake > local_var:sr_ebr_tg_makemake }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_src value = 32 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_srcn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebf_at_makemake subtract = local_var:sr_ebr_tg_makemake } }

	else = {
		# The checkbox (§ 8.3): from the place in use that earns least a level (ties to the

		# the gap is at least the margin, and never to a place that loses money.

		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebi_room_tranquility > local_var:sr_ebf_at_tranquility local_var:sr_ebi_p_tranquility > local_var:sr_ebf_dstp } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_dst value = 37 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_dstp value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_tranquility } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_dstn value = { value = local_var:sr_ebi_room_tranquility subtract = local_var:sr_ebf_at_tranquility } } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebf_at_marius_hills > 0 local_var:sr_ebi_p_marius_hills <= local_var:sr_ebf_srcp } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_src value = 38 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_srcp value = local_var:sr_ebi_p_marius_hills } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebf_srcn value = local_var:sr_ebf_at_marius_hills } }

# § 9.1's totals (ebase_ground.totals), goods and £ a week before other modifiers, players
# only: "Now" from where the levels work (sr_ebm_at_<k>) into var:sr_eb_now_<good> and
# var:sr_eb_now_profit; "If prices hold" or "At our assignments" from the forecast's counts
# (sr_ebf_at_<k>) into var:sr_eb_end_<good> and var:sr_eb_end_profit. A good's output: each
# place's levels x (100 + grade) x (1 + mix) / 100 x sr_eb_out_<good>, the levels past the
# room at 25% as Mixed. Profit: each place's levels x its profit a level, the levels
# past the room included. After sr_eb_read_inputs and sr_eb_forecast.
sr_eb_totals = {
	set_local_variable = {
		name = sr_ebt_sum
		value = {
			value = local_var:sr_ebm_over
			multiply = 25
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_near_earth multiply = 100 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_valles_marineris multiply = 138.844 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_olympus_mons multiply = 138.844 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hellas_planitia multiply = 138.844 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_utopia_planitia multiply = 110.38524 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_arcadia_planitia multiply = 110.38524 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_ceres multiply = 95.16801 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_vesta multiply = 151.46618 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_psyche multiply = 145.22054 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_pallas multiply = 91.03027 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_hygiea multiply = 86.89253 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_io multiply = 79.83644 }
			add = { value = local_var:sr_ebm_at_europa multiply = 79.83644 }

# A click on the checkbox or on - or + (sr_colony_sguis.txt), after it has changed the
# targets: the totals, the forecast and the next place recomputed at once, so the panel
# shows the change before the month runs. It moves no level: only sr_eb_month does.
sr_eb_after_click = {
	sr_eb_read_click_inputs = yes
	sr_eb_load = yes
	sr_eb_forecast = yes
	sr_eb_totals = yes
	sr_eb_next_place = yes
}

# Switching Assign for the most profit off (§ 8.4, ebase_ground.set_checkbox): each place's
# target becomes its levels and those it is owed (a blockaded site's levels, back, meet
# their own target), so nothing moves until the player changes one. Only the two scripted
# GUIs call it: the AI never sets sr_eb_manual. Moves no level.
sr_eb_checkbox_off = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_eb_manual } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_near_earth } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_at_near_earth } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_near_earth } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_away_near_earth } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_near_earth value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_near_earth } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_near_earth }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_valles_marineris } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_at_valles_marineris } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_valles_marineris } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_away_valles_marineris } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_valles_marineris value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_valles_marineris } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_valles_marineris }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_olympus_mons } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_at_olympus_mons } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_olympus_mons } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_away_olympus_mons } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_olympus_mons value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_olympus_mons } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_olympus_mons }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_hellas_planitia } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_at_hellas_planitia } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_hellas_planitia } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_away_hellas_planitia } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_hellas_planitia value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_hellas_planitia } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_hellas_planitia }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_utopia_planitia } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_at_utopia_planitia } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_utopia_planitia } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_away_utopia_planitia } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_utopia_planitia value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_utopia_planitia } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_utopia_planitia }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_arcadia_planitia } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_at_arcadia_planitia } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_arcadia_planitia } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_away_arcadia_planitia } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_arcadia_planitia value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_arcadia_planitia } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_arcadia_planitia }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_at_ceres } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_at_ceres } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_ceres } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_away_ceres } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_ceres value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }

		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_away_vesta } change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_n add = var:sr_eb_away_vesta } }
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_vesta value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }

		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_n > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_psyche value = local_var:sr_eba_n } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_psyche } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_psyche }

# Switching it back on: the targets are dropped, and the checkbox's moves start from where
# the levels are, at the same pace.

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_marius_hills } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_daedalus } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_imbrium } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_imbrium }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_manual } remove_variable = sr_eb_manual }
}

# § 8.4's - and + (ebase_ground.assign), from sr_ebase_assign_sgui: scope:site is the place's
# index, scope:op 1 = +5, 2 = -5, 3 = +25, 4 = -25. A click with the checkbox on
# switches it off first, keeping where the levels are as the targets. Minus stops at 0;
# plus at the place's room while we hold it, and at the unassigned levels (built and
# queued, sr_ebase_queued_levels, less the targets). Moves no level.
sr_eb_assign = {
	sr_eb_checkbox_off = yes
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_step value = 5 }
	if = { limit = { OR = { scope:op = 3 scope:op = 4 } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_step value = 25 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_free value = { value = sr_ebase_queued_levels subtract = sr_eb_assigned } }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:site = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_near_earth } set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = var:sr_eb_target_near_earth } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { scope:op = 2 scope:op = 4 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = { value = local_var:sr_eba_tg subtract = local_var:sr_eba_step min = 0 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = local_var:sr_eba_step max = local_var:sr_eba_free } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = sr_eb_held_room_near_earth subtract = local_var:sr_eba_tg max = local_var:sr_eba_add min = 0 } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg add = local_var:sr_eba_add }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_tg > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_near_earth value = local_var:sr_eba_tg } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_near_earth } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_near_earth }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:site = 1 }

			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = sr_eb_held_room_tranquility subtract = local_var:sr_eba_tg max = local_var:sr_eba_add min = 0 } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg add = local_var:sr_eba_add }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_tg > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_tranquility value = local_var:sr_eba_tg } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_tranquility } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_tranquility }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:site = 38 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_marius_hills } set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = var:sr_eb_target_marius_hills } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { scope:op = 2 scope:op = 4 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = { value = local_var:sr_eba_tg subtract = local_var:sr_eba_step min = 0 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = local_var:sr_eba_step max = local_var:sr_eba_free } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = sr_eb_held_room_marius_hills subtract = local_var:sr_eba_tg max = local_var:sr_eba_add min = 0 } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg add = local_var:sr_eba_add }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_tg > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_marius_hills value = local_var:sr_eba_tg } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_marius_hills } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_marius_hills }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:site = 39 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_daedalus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = var:sr_eb_target_daedalus } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { scope:op = 2 scope:op = 4 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = { value = local_var:sr_eba_tg subtract = local_var:sr_eba_step min = 0 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = local_var:sr_eba_step max = local_var:sr_eba_free } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = sr_eb_held_room_daedalus subtract = local_var:sr_eba_tg max = local_var:sr_eba_add min = 0 } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg add = local_var:sr_eba_add }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_tg > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_daedalus value = local_var:sr_eba_tg } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_daedalus } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_daedalus }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:site = 40 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_imbrium } set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = var:sr_eb_target_imbrium } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { scope:op = 2 scope:op = 4 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg value = { value = local_var:sr_eba_tg subtract = local_var:sr_eba_step min = 0 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = local_var:sr_eba_step max = local_var:sr_eba_free } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_add value = { value = sr_eb_held_room_imbrium subtract = local_var:sr_eba_tg max = local_var:sr_eba_add min = 0 } }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_eba_tg add = local_var:sr_eba_add }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:sr_eba_tg > 0 } set_variable = { name = sr_eb_target_imbrium value = local_var:sr_eba_tg } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_eb_target_imbrium } remove_variable = sr_eb_target_imbrium }
	}
}

# § 9.4, the move notice (ebase_ground.notice_due), from the refresh after the month:
# when Assign for the most profit is moving levels toward a different ground type, once the
# move has carried 0.05 of our levels (sr_eb_notice_threshold), for a pair of types
# other than the last notice's, and at least 12 months after it. Players only; never for
# the player's own moves (the checkbox off). It names the good whose value a level gains
# most from the source to the destination at today's prices (ebase_ground.notice_good).
# The notice's own record: sr_eb_notice_from and _to (the places, for its text),
# sr_eb_notice_ft and _tt (their types' indices in ebase_ground.TYPES), sr_eb_notice_good
# (an index in GOODS) and sr_eb_notice_next (the first month the next one may go out).
sr_eb_move_notice = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_variable = sr_eb_manual }
			has_variable = sr_eb_move_from
			has_variable = sr_eb_move_to
			has_variable = sr_eb_move_carried
			var:sr_eb_move_carried >= sr_eb_notice_threshold
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = sr_eb_notice_next }
				te_history_month_index >= var:sr_eb_notice_next
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_from value = var:sr_eb_move_from }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_to value = var:sr_eb_move_to }
		# Each place's type, and each good's score x 100, (100 + grade) x (1 + mix)
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_from = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_ft value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_s_iron value = 100 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_s_tech_metals value = 100 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_s_gold value = 100 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_s_copper value = 100 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = sr_eb_notice_ft
				has_variable = sr_eb_notice_tt
				var:sr_eb_notice_ft = local_var:sr_ebq_ft
				var:sr_eb_notice_tt = local_var:sr_ebq_tt
			}

		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_same = 0 NOT = { local_var:sr_ebq_ft = local_var:sr_ebq_tt } }
			# The good whose value a level gains most, at today's prices (ties to the first)
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_best value = -1000000000 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_good value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = local_var:sr_ebq_d_iron subtract = local_var:sr_ebq_s_iron } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = sr_eb_price_rel_iron add = 1 multiply = 10000 multiply = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_gap > local_var:sr_ebq_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_best value = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_good value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = local_var:sr_ebq_d_tech_metals subtract = local_var:sr_ebq_s_tech_metals } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = sr_eb_price_rel_tech_metals add = 1 multiply = 14000 multiply = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_gap > local_var:sr_ebq_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_best value = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_good value = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = local_var:sr_ebq_d_gold subtract = local_var:sr_ebq_s_gold } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = sr_eb_price_rel_gold add = 1 multiply = 5000 multiply = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_gap > local_var:sr_ebq_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_best value = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_good value = 2 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = local_var:sr_ebq_d_copper subtract = local_var:sr_ebq_s_copper } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = sr_eb_price_rel_copper add = 1 multiply = 3800 multiply = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_gap > local_var:sr_ebq_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_best value = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_good value = 3 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = local_var:sr_ebq_d_lead subtract = local_var:sr_ebq_s_lead } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = sr_eb_price_rel_lead add = 1 multiply = 400 multiply = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_gap > local_var:sr_ebq_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_best value = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_good value = 4 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = local_var:sr_ebq_d_sulfur subtract = local_var:sr_ebq_s_sulfur } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = sr_eb_price_rel_sulfur add = 1 multiply = 1250 multiply = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_gap > local_var:sr_ebq_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_best value = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_good value = 5 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = local_var:sr_ebq_d_glass subtract = local_var:sr_ebq_s_glass } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_gap value = { value = sr_eb_price_rel_glass add = 1 multiply = 2800 multiply = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_ebq_gap > local_var:sr_ebq_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_best value = local_var:sr_ebq_gap } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ebq_good value = 6 } }
			set_variable = { name = sr_eb_notice_from value = local_var:sr_ebq_from }
			set_variable = { name = sr_eb_notice_to value = local_var:sr_ebq_to }
			set_variable = { name = sr_eb_notice_ft value = local_var:sr_ebq_ft }
			set_variable = { name = sr_eb_notice_tt value = local_var:sr_ebq_tt }
			set_variable = { name = sr_eb_notice_good value = local_var:sr_ebq_good }
			set_variable = {
				name = sr_eb_notice_next
				value = { value = te_history_month_index add = 12 }
			}
			post_notification = sr_ebase_move_notice
		}
	}
}
